_comment: The half of the registry that cannot come from a chain. Legal structure, custody, redemption rights and dividend treatment live in documents an issuer publishes, so each one is curated here with a disclosureUrl beside it. Everything else (supply, authorities, extensions, depth, prices) is read live by pipeline/src/run.ts and must never be written here.

issuers.name: Backed Finance (xStocks)
issuers.structure: Tracker certificate issued under a Liechtenstein base prospectus

issuers.name: Ondo Finance
issuers.structure: Tokenized note issued by a bankruptcy-remote SPV
issuers.regulator: SEC-registered transfer agent in the structure

issuers.name: PreStocks
issuers.structure: Synthetic price tracker, no stated share custody

tokens.name: Apple Inc.
tokens.dividendTreatment: Cash dividends accrue into the certificate's value rather than being paid out, so the token price steps up instead of you receiving cash.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Splits and mergers are passed through by the issuer, who adjusts the certificate ratio.
tokens.issuerRisk: You hold a certificate issued by Backed, not the share itself. If the issuer fails, you are a creditor against the collateral pool, not an Apple shareholder.

tokens.name: NVIDIA Corporation
tokens.dividendTreatment: Accrues into the certificate value. NVIDIA's yield is negligible either way.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Passed through. The 2024 10-for-1 split was handled by ratio adjustment.
tokens.issuerRisk: Creditor claim against Backed's collateral pool if the issuer fails, not a direct NVIDIA holding.

tokens.name: Microsoft Corporation
tokens.dividendTreatment: Dividends are collected by the SPV and reflected in NAV. Holders do not receive cash directly.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Handled at the SPV level; token supply is adjusted to match.
tokens.issuerRisk: The SPV is bankruptcy-remote, which is stronger than an operating-company claim, but redemption runs through authorized participants. Retail exits by selling.

tokens.name: Tesla, Inc.
tokens.dividendTreatment: Tesla pays no dividend, so the question has not been tested for this token.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: Stated as handled by the exchange. No published mechanism for how a split is reflected on-chain.
tokens.issuerRisk: The custodian and the issuer are the same company. That is one balance sheet standing behind both halves of the claim, which is materially weaker than a third-party custodian.

tokens.name: OpenAI (pre-IPO exposure)
tokens.dividendTreatment: Not applicable. Nothing is held and nothing is paid.
tokens.corporateActionPolicy: None. There is no share for an action to happen to.
tokens.issuerRisk: This token holds nothing. Its price is whatever the pool says it is, and the reference is an estimated private valuation, not a traded price. If the issuer stops supporting it, the only floor is the pool.

tokens.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A
tokens.issuerRisk: Creditor claim against the Backed collateral pool if the issuer fails.
